annotations.text:
THE INTAKE — paid, six screens.
The order is the product: what is fixed, who is affected, what you have, the money, what you would trade, and only then where you want to end up.

THE MAP — the same product, both directions. JAKE closes the gap by earning more. MARCUS closes it by needing less, and his plan crosses OUT starting a business. One example is one product; this is why there are two.
THE FREE DIAGNOSTIC — public, six taps, rules not a model. Naming what does NOT fit is what earns the next click.

THE OPENING SCREEN — three bets on the first fifteen seconds, same visual system.

RECOGNITION names something true about the reader — safest, but still asks to be believed.
DEMONSTRATION shows the shape of an answer before asking for anything — strongest proof, shows the hand early.
QUESTION starts being useful immediately — best completion, but a stranger has been told nothing, and it can read as a quiz funnel.
